name: Cash Flow Calculator
meta_description: Project your business cash balance month by month for a year. See your lowest balance, months you run negative and the extra cash you need to stay safe.
subtitle: Enter your starting cash and the money you expect in and out each month to see your balance across the next 12 months, your lowest point and any months you would run out of cash.
